  "rationale": "The supplied rule requires 30-day retention. Users reportedly recreate drafts because the Delete label suggests that hiding erased their work. “Hide draft” names the effect accurately, and “Show draft again” gives users a recovery path both immediately and after the message disappears. The unspecified retention start supports omitting a countdown. The verification plan covers keyboard recovery, screen-reader feedback, draft identity and contents, the existing deadline, and other drafts. The execution events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match."
